points.summary: PR is too broad and not suitable as-is
Should resubmit from clean branch with one focused change
Nexus does not intend to introduce LLM/AI capabilities
Nexus is pure headless AST-driven editor engine; LLM is host app's concern
PR did not follow OpenSpec process (CONTRIBUTING.md §3.1)
Modified project/agent instruction files should not be overwritten
Added entire Python subproject (llm-wiki) not acceptable in TS monorepo
Committed build artifacts violating .gitignore and governance rules
Deleted 3006 lines including others' planning/spec files
Large PR size (+8586/-3006, 52 files) and CLA not signed
Suggested using engine's atomic capabilities in own project/fork
If engine lacks capability, propose via OpenSpec for core layer
